CustomField.description: Contractual monthly rent for the unit. This is the DENOMINATOR of Months Outstanding - the metric FSD 5.9.1 says the business actually reasons in. If it is blank or zero, Months Outstanding is blank and the FSD 5.9.9 PM ranking loses this row entirely.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Monthly rent from the Yardi feed. If blank, Months Outstanding cannot be calculated. Yardi-sourced and overwritten on every nightly sync. Never edit this value in Salesforce - it will be replaced.
CustomField.label: Monthly Rent
